title: GPT Image 2.6 Flare Custom
description: Fast image generation and edits with custom sizing, masks, markup hints, and GIF output. Try GPT Image 2.6 Flare Custom by OpenAI on Wiro now.
pricing: Set by the run when it ends: Pricing is calculated from input and output tokens reported by OpenAI: text input $5 / 1M tokens, image input $8 / 1M tokens, image output $30 / 1M tokens. SVG output also bills the gpt-6.1-terra tokens that write the SVG: $1 / 1M input, $5 / 1M output. The final price is computed when the task finishes.

items.label: Input Images
items.note: Optional. Input images to edit, up to 16. With input images the output can be an image or an animated GIF. If the output format is svg, input images are not used: the SVG is made from the prompt alone.

items.label: Prompt
items.sample: Turn every chess piece into clear cut crystal glass, the light pieces in clear crystal and the dark pieces in smoky amber crystal, each glowing softly from inside and casting colorful light refractions on the board. Keep the position of every piece, the wooden board, the table, the plant and the window light exactly the same.
items.note: Required. Text description of the desired image, image edit, GIF animation or SVG. Maximum 32,000 characters.

items.label: Width
items.note: Required. Output width in pixels, at most 3840. Images and SVG: long:short ratio at most 3:1 and 655,360–8,294,400 total pixels; non-16-aligned values are snapped and resized to your exact request. GIF: the width of each frame, snapped to a multiple of 16; frames that would not fit together are shrunk.

items.label: Height
items.note: Required. Output height in pixels, at most 3840. Images and SVG: long:short ratio at most 3:1 and 655,360–8,294,400 total pixels; non-16-aligned values are snapped and resized to your exact request. GIF: the height of each frame, snapped to a multiple of 16; frames that would not fit together are shrunk.

items.label: Number of Images
items.note: Required. Number of images to generate (1-10). SVG output always makes 1.

items.label: Output Format
items.note: Optional. Default jpeg. Output format. gif makes an animated GIF, with or without input images. svg makes a vector image from the prompt alone; input images, mask and markup are not used.

items.label: Frame Count (GIF)
items.note: Optional. Default 9. Number of frames in the GIF (2-16). GIF output only.

items.label: Frame Duration (GIF)
items.note: Optional. Default 200. How long each frame shows, in milliseconds (20-2000, rounded to 10). GIF output only.

items.label: SVG Reasoning (SVG)
items.note: Optional. Default low. How much gpt-6.1-terra, which writes the SVG, reasons before drawing. Higher can give cleaner, more detailed vectors at a higher cost. SVG output only.

items.label: Mask Image (Edit)
items.note: Optional. Requires an input image. Mask image that defines the areas to edit. Not used with GIF or SVG output.

items.label: Markup Image (Edit)
items.note: Optional. Requires an input image. A transparent overlay with marks (a circle, an arrow) showing where the prompt's change should go. Not used with SVG output.

items.label: Complexity
items.note: Optional. Default high. How much the model plans before rendering: lower suits focused edits, higher helps dense text and complex layouts. It does not change the price.

items.label: Background
items.note: Optional. Default auto. Background setting. Transparent needs png or webp output; with jpeg it switches to png.

items.label: Output Compression
items.note: Optional. Default 100. Compression level (0-100) for jpeg or webp output only.

items.label: Moderation Level
items.note: Optional. Default low. Content moderation level.
